text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The "chan" is the "chan" from the Ultra 
Super Mascot, Lovely Chan-chan-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How is it? It's the Chan-chan memory song 
that I practiced over the break!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I've improved much more than usual. With 
this, Machan's lovely voice will 
definitely be stuck in everyone's heads!"

Aston Machan kept singing with heartfelt 
passion. It seemed she had spent a truly 
fulfilling day off!
